ValidationRule.description: Validation Rule To Throw An Error When Company Signed Date Is Not The Last date Of a Selected Month
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: CompanySignedDate <> IF(MONTH(CompanySignedDate) = 12, DATE(YEAR(CompanySignedDate), MONTH(CompanySignedDate), 31), DATE(YEAR(CompanySignedDate), MONTH(CompanySignedDate) + 1, 1) - 1)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Company Signed Should Be Only Date Of a Month
